RoomPlayer.title: RoomPlayer
RoomPlayer.description: Public player entry stored inside the Room.players map. Strictly excludes secret roles.

name.description: Display name entered by the student.

color.description: Hex color associated with the wristband badge.

isAlive.description: Whether the player is still alive in the current match.

hasVoted.description: Whether the player has cast a vote in the active meeting.

MeetingInfo.title: MeetingInfo
MeetingInfo.description: Active emergency meeting or body report metadata.

callerBadgeId.description: Wristband badge ID of the player who called the meeting.

bodyBadgeId.description: Optional wristband badge ID of the eliminated player reported.

endsAt.description: Epoch millisecond timestamp when discussion/voting concludes.

Room.title: Room
Room.description: Public match state for a Campus Among Us IRL room. Never stores player roles.

winner.description: Winning team when status is ENDED.

taskProgress.description: Global team task completion percentage from 0 to 100.

activeSabotage.description: Currently active sabotage event, if any.

sabotageExpiresAt.description: Epoch millisecond timestamp when active sabotage expires.

meetingInfo.description: Active meeting payload when status is MEETING.

ejectionResult.description: Announcement summary after a meeting vote concludes.

players.description: Public players map keyed by badgeId containing ONLY { badgeId, name, color, isAlive, hasVoted }.

impostorCount.description: Configured number of Impostors for this match (1 to 4). Used to derive totalCrewmates without exposing individual roles.

hostUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the room host.

badgeOwners.description: Map of badgeId -> Firebase Auth UID used for wristband ownership enforcement.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest room mutation.

PrivateRole.title: PrivateRole
PrivateRole.description: Private role and task assignment document isolated per wristband.

fellowImpostors.description: Badge IDs of fellow Impostors (empty for Crewmates).

assignedStations.description: Station IDs assigned to this player (4 random stations from TASK_STATIONS).

completedStations.description: Subset of assignedStations completed by this player.

Vote.title: Vote
Vote.description: Emergency meeting vote cast by a living player.

voterBadgeId.description: Badge ID of the living player casting this vote.

participantUids.description: Room participant Auth UIDs authorized to tally votes.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the vote was cast.

/rooms/{roomCode}.description: Public game room document containing room status, sabotage, meeting state, and public player metadata (no roles).

/rooms/{roomCode}/privateRoles/{badgeId}.description: Strictly isolated per-player secret role and assigned campus stations.

/rooms/{roomCode}/votes/{badgeId}.description: Live emergency meeting votes cast by living players.
